lines.lyric_translation: Let’s go in for a bit

lines.lyric: Yeminhan nari seon shigye sori naneun bang
lines.lyric_hangul: 예민한 날이 선 시계 소리 나는 방
lines.lyric_translation: The sensitive and sharp sound of the clock can be heard in this room
The questions get shorter / In comparison to the curiosity
Silence is breaking in our conversation
Unhappy feelings are filling up
It’s overflowing, can’t do this anymore
Our surroundings are buried with sighs, it’s quiet

lines.lyric_hangul: 숨 막힐 듯해도, 입 다물고 있는 게 차라리 속 편해
lines.lyric_translation: It’s suffocating but it’s better / To keep my mouth shut

parts.lyric: Sum makhil deuthaedo ip damulgo itneun ge

lines.lyric_hangul: 딱딱해진 관계 해 소되지 않은 싸움
lines.lyric_translation: Our hardened relationship / Our unsolved fights

lines.lyric_hangul: 끝내 열리는 방문 원점이 돼, 고개 돌린 채
lines.lyric_translation: The opening door is becoming the focus point / As we turn our heads
Let’s talk next time
We’re wandering in the same place again
Everything feels so unfamiliar
Is it the end this time?

lines.lyric_translation: I don’t know, I don’t know
